name: slicer-difficulty-v1
declared: 2026-10-22, before any agent was trained or evaluated on a held-out setting
excluded_agents: Tabular Q (its GridQuest state is a map-specific position index and cannot transfer by construction) and the SB3 references (no curve protocol exists for them yet).
setting_notes: speed scales both sampled object velocities (default range: vertical 0.03-0.055, horizontal +/-0.015 per tick); bomb_ratio is the chance a spawned object is a bomb. Horizon (80), cursor step (0.12), slice window (0.14) and rewards are unchanged.
training: Frozen 20 October curve protocol (analysis/curves.py PROTOCOL): 20,480 environment steps, checkpoints every 1,024 steps, DQN epsilon 1.0 to 0.05 over 3,584 absolute steps, PPO 512-step rollouts, every other hyperparameter at its code default. Nothing is tuned for this protocol.
eval_seed_rule: 7000 + training seed on every setting, a seed block no earlier run used; episode e resets with seed (7000 + training seed) * 100000 + e
consistency_rule: Training-setting models are also evaluated on the default Slicer with evaluation seed 1000 + training seed at every checkpoint. Those 210 rows must equal evidence/learning_curve_20480.json (score, bomb hits, return and parameter fingerprint).
eval_policy: greedy (argmax), as in the curve protocol

anchors.random: uniform random action, numpy default_rng(evaluation seed)
anchors.scripted: fixed rule written before any held-out evaluation: stay on a bomb; on a fruit, slice if next-tick y > 0.2 and |cursor - next-tick x| < 0.14, otherwise step toward next-tick x when more than 0.06 away

primary_metric: Per-seed mean fruit score over the 30 evaluation episodes at 20,480 steps, for training-setting models on each setting; five-seed mean with the seed-level bootstrap 95% interval (analysis.aggregate). Mean bomb hits reported alongside.
secondary_metrics: anchor-normalized score per seed, (agent - random) / (scripted - random), using the anchors on the same evaluation episodes; defined for a setting only if scripted beats random by more than 0.5 fruit on every evaluation seed
transfer gap = in-setting reference mean minus training-setting model mean on that held-out setting at 20,480 steps, with a 2,000-resample bootstrap over the two independent five-seed groups
held-out score at every 1,024-step checkpoint, descriptive only; no checkpoint is selected as best
decision_rule: For each agent and held-out setting: 'transfer loss' if the gap's 95% interval lies above 0, 'transfer gain' if below 0, otherwise 'no measurable difference' (with five seeds this is not evidence of equivalence). Every result is reported, whatever its direction.
tuning: None. Settings, seeds, budgets, anchors and metrics are frozen by this protocol; misses and failures are reported, not re-run.
